metadata.title: Anthropic IPO values company at $1.5 trillion ahead of stock's Thursday trading debut — live updates - MarketWatch

content.text:
CONCLUDED
Nov. 19, 2026 at 7:11am ET
Anthropic IPO values company at $1.5 trillion ahead of stock's Thursday trading debut — live updates
Follow along with MarketWatch's live coverage of the Anthropic IPO before shares start trading on Thursday.
Anthropic’s initial public offering has divided retail investors, with some leaning in and others staying far away.
Similar to what SpaceX did with its own IPO, Anthropic has moved to allocate about 20% of its offering to retail investors, according to its prospectus. That could mean that smaller investors will get a rare opportunity to participate in such a massive IPO — and become exposed to the risks that come with that.
In its paperwork, Anthropic warned that its decisions "may not prioritize short-term financial results and may not align with investor expectations or preferences, which could adversely affect the market price" of shares.
Anthropic wants everyday investors to be part of its IPO. Some are not buying it.
“It’s total hype and kind of inflated expectations.”
